description: Cross-repo compatibility matrix — single source of truth (#466). Builder and Studio CI read this file to check their kpubdata dependency range.
update_policy: Update on every kpubdata release. Builder/Studio link here, never copy.

matrix.note: Cross-repo E2E (#282) runs against main branches

2026-09 release. Builder and Studio share one version (kpubdata ADR 0004); the kpubdata column is what uv.lock pinned, not the declared range (>=0.6.0,<0.7). kpubdata 0.7.0 is outside it — see builder#746.
